SELECT MIN(company_movies.movie_company) AS movie_company,
       MIN(rating_movies.rating) AS rating,
       MIN(relevant_titles.title) AS western_violent_movie
FROM (
    SELECT t.id AS movie_id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
    WHERE t.production_year > 2008
      AND kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
) AS relevant_titles
JOIN (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, MIN(cn.name) AS movie_company
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
         AND cn.country_code != '[us]'
    WHERE mc.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%'
      AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
    GROUP BY mc.movie_id
) AS company_movies ON company_movies.movie_id = relevant_titles.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
) AS keyword_movies ON keyword_movies.movie_id = relevant_titles.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN (
        SELECT id
        FROM info_type
        WHERE info = 'countries'
    ) AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
) AS country_info_movies ON country_info_movies.movie_id = relevant_titles.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id, MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
    JOIN (
        SELECT id
        FROM info_type
        WHERE info = 'rating'
    ) AS it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
    WHERE mi_idx.info < '7.0'
    GROUP BY mi_idx.movie_id
) AS rating_movies ON rating_movies.movie_id = relevant_titles.movie_id
